title: [DEV] Combo: Cancelled TBR alarms
body:
I'm on dev branch and as I already mentioned in Discord, I'm getting frequent cancelled TBR alarms on my Combo.
AAPS 3.0 doesn't have this problem.
These alarms are occurring in the middle of pump communication and I have to confirm them manually on the pump.
There are sometimes two alarms a day, sometimes five in only one hour, but I get them constantly.

I tracked the problem down to commit [Combo: cleanup code](https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/commit/ad8c2297a01a9165f1e9babc29f63bb9bf46e8f4), with this commit reverted, I'm running without any cancelled TBR alarms for 10 days now.
This commit doesn't change much but introducing the logging.AAPSLogger and switching some bits from Java to Kotlin.
The logs seem to point to timeouts reported by Ruffy: [AndroidAPS.log](https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/files/8489246/AndroidAPS.log)
Any Idea what could cause this?

comments.body:
Can confirm this, reverting the commit also works.
Was also experiencing more frequent disconnects from the pump (probably due to the cancelled TBR alarms)

The reason for the alarms might be a timing issue within RuffyScripter. AAPSLogger seems to be slower than the old slf4j logger.
Removing all aapsLogger.debug lines ("Ruffy says ...") in RuffyScripter.java solves the problem.
What could be a possible solution? Ignoring? Disabling debug logging in RuffyScripter??
Or is there a simple way to disable debug logging for dev builds?

Thanks a lot @jotomo 
Didn't notice the change of log level.
Closed :)
